teams.heading: Ireland women defeat Japan with seven tries in Cork Test match
teams.body: The Ireland women’s side secured a comprehensive 43-19 victory over Japan at Virgin Media Park on Saturday, marking their second consecutive win against the visitors. Beibhinn Parsons also crossed to extend her all-time Ireland try-scoring record to 25. The team now turns its attention to a two-match series against South Africa in the WXV.

teams.heading: Scotland women suffer heavy second-half defeat against Australia in Edinburgh
teams.body: The Scotland women's side were defeated 30-10 by Australia at Hive Stadium after failing to maintain their interval lead. Despite entering the break 10-5 ahead following a try from Evie Gallagher and points from Helen Nelson, the hosts conceded 25 unanswered points in the second half. Following a captain's speech, Australia executed a clinical comeback, scoring three tries in eight minutes. Scotland were further hampered when Gallagher was sent to the sin-bin during a crucial period of the match.

teams.heading: André Esterhuizen and Edwill van der Merwe star as Sharks defeat Leinster
teams.body: Skipper André Esterhuizen and winger Edwill van der Merwe scored tries as a Springbok-laden Sharks side defeated Leinster 26-20 in Durban on Saturday. Sharks coach JP Pietersen recalled six Boks for the round two fixture, with Esterhuizen taking over the captaincy and Thomas du Toit starting at loosehead. Manu Tshituka and Lili Bester also crossed the whitewash to secure a bonus-point triumph at Kings Park, keeping the Durbanites unbeaten through two rounds.
